features:
Key Features:

Made with whole grain: Each half-cup serving contains about 12 g of whole grain, aligning toward daily recommendations. 

Just add water: No eggs, milk, or oil needed – mix with water and cook pancakes or waffles.

Versatile baking mix: Suitable not only for pancakes and waffles but also for biscuits, dumplings, pancakes, and more. 

Standard ingredients: Includes enriched bleached flour, whole wheat flour, sugar, buttermilk, defatted soy flour, oils (canola/palm), leavening agents, salt, eggs, and DATEM.

Benefits:

Quick & convenient: Perfect for making fluffy pancakes or waffles in minutes with minimal prep.

Whole grain support: Helps contribute to daily whole grain intake (12 g per serving). 

Customizable recipes: You can mix in bananas, oats, spices, or use as a base for other baked goods.

Rich in micronutrients: Provides added iron, calcium, and B-vitamins from enriched flour—5 g protein per serving.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, malted barley flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Defatted Soy Flour, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Palm Oil, Dextrose, Buttermilk, Salt, DATEM.
